caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher, illustrated entirely in shades of blue on a light background. The pitcher features a broad base with a fluted design, a curved spout, and an elaborately decorated handle with leaf-like patterns. The upper section of the pitcher is adorned with a decorative frieze, while the central body displays a detailed scene with two figures on horseback in motion, surrounded by foliage and trees. One figure appears to be holding a raised object, possibly a weapon, and both are dressed in period attire, with hats and flowing garments. To the left, there is a partial depiction of another figure on horseback, and to the right, architectural elements such as a fence and a cross are visible amidst the background vegetation. Swirling decorative patterns accentuate the shoulder just below the spout and handle. The entire composition is rendered with fine lines and shading, providing depth and texture to both the vessel and the scene depicted upon it.
title: Beer Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
